title: email/types.rs: id, blob_id, ipfs_cid all store identical CID string
description:
Why this issue exists: Email struct has three fields (id, blob_id, ipfs_cid) that all hold the same CID string value. This is 3x allocation for no semantic benefit.

What needs to be done: Store the CID once and derive the other two at serialization time, or compute them inline when building the JMAP response JSON.
